changes_this_cycle: Added schemas/mundarica_artifact.schema.json as the provenance-safe registration contract for authoritative scans, raw OCR, working/verified transcriptions, structured content, page images and related corpus artifacts.
Required every registered artifact to retain source ID, volume, artifact role, locator, rights status, access class, verification status and provenance.
Encoded the rule that authoritative scans carry scan authority and raw OCR cannot be labelled verified_against_scan.
Added tests for the 16-volume ID range, artifact-role separation, provenance/rights/access requirements and OCR/scan verification safety rules.
Updated the Streamlit smoke workflow so schema changes trigger CI and the Mundarica artifact contract is tested before completeness and UI smoke gates.

streamlit_sync.detail: No Mundarica manifest, page-accounting, transcription, structured-content or verification value changed in this cycle, so no public corpus metric required resynchronization. CI was expanded so schema/corpus-contract changes are part of the Streamlit release gate.

tests.state_at_record_time: new checks triggered / awaiting final conclusion

blockers: Volume I repository bundle still lacks a registered authoritative scan artifact, so visual scan comparison cannot be certified.
Volumes II-XVI still have no corpus artifacts in the current repository build.
next_best_action: After CI confirms the artifact contract, add a blank artifact-register template/registry that can accept an authoritative Volume I scan without claiming rights or verification, then expose registered-artifact/scan-presence state in Streamlit when that registry gains real records.
